key_insight: A coordinated paid-content network uses promotional posts on UGC platforms to gain visibility in generative-engine answers.
engineering_relevance: Defending retrieval-augmented systems against coordinated promotion requires account- and platform-level signals beyond content-level screening.
method: Map one paid-content operation across three major Chinese UGC platforms.
Analyze associated accounts, inferred promotional placements, and campaign evolution.
Evaluate network citations across nine generative engines and client mentions across eight.
evidence_signal: The study identified 1,985 associated accounts and 466,357 inferred promotional placements; network pages represented 4.5%–20% of retrievable cited pages, while clients appeared in 52% of evaluated answers versus 68% for category leaders.
watch_item: Findings concern one network, and citation attribution varies with strictness, limiting generalization to other GEO operations.
paper_title: GEOHunter: Mapping a Generative Engine Optimization Network in the Wild
